Budget 50; 44-45 used. Best=1.751 = 9-column tree ('','B','T','BB','BT','TB','BBT','BTT','BTTB'; TB=55/5/4, BTT=60/6/5, BTTB=40/6/5). Re-asserted via revert so a valid high design stays on file.

LESSONS: (1) TT (535 mol/s: C3 39/nC4 24/iC4 16/C3= 14/C2 6) is $0; splitting it loses more in column cost than it earns (my probe->1.590; agent9 70/8/6 probe->1.509; agent6 TB-deeper->1.683). (2) TBT nC4 98% already sells pure ($118M); pushing TB deeper flips it to cheaper C4-mix (agent6 R1603 ->1.683). (3) All $0 streams (TT 535, BBB 636, BBTB 271, BTTBB 123) too contaminated; deep splits (90-stage->1.465; 80-stage->1.451) lose >$130M. (4) Cost-trimming the feed/B columns broke purity (-0.311). (5) Largest buried value = C6 naphthenes (MCP+CH 269 mol/s) in BBTB/BBT/BBB, but CH(353.9) vs C6 paraffins(333-342) is very hard and unproven.

CONCLUSION: 1.751 is a genuine local optimum for this topology; no plausible upside within remaining budget. FINAL: finish at 1.751.
